programme_facts.value: It is extremely important that you submit the documents required for the issuance of your I-20 to us.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: Upload the required documents through My ASU. The upload tool on My ASU only allows the upload of each document type once.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: If you upload financial documents that do not cover the full funding needed as shown on the financial guarantee, you will be asked to submit additional documentation.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: Once ASU has received all documents required to issue an I-20 and has verified that they are complete, you will receive an email with a link to download your I-20.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: Be sure to check your non-ASU personal email address often, including junk and spam folders, so you do not miss any messages.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: Once you have received your I-20, be sure to pay your I-901 fee.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: Once the fee has been paid do not delay in contacting your consulate to obtain a visa appointment.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: If you are unable to submit the documentation needed to receive an I-20 from ASU or are unable to obtain your F1 visa in time, contact [email protected] for advice on your options.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: View the I-20 Frequently Asked Questions webpage for more information.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: Be sure to check wait times for your local embassy or consulate, as some areas may be experiencing wait times longer than 30 days.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

programme_facts.value: You can now apply for your visa up to 365 days before the start date listed on your I-20.
